title: benchmarks.py repro record merges the run's per-area results into benchmarks.csv as the repro scenario
goal: repro record merges the json lines repro run appends under DIR into kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv as the scenario repro, with record the start sha's first 7 characters, arm instance-N, case the area and the metrics cost, input, out, cache_read, cache_write, turns, tool_calls, wall_s, models, failure, main_before and main_after, and the start sha and the sha256 of the briefs and of the questions in the note; a second repro record of the same lines changes nothing; repro record --dry-run prints the rows it would merge and writes nothing, exiting 0 with no lines; no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle gains a body that records planted json lines twice.
